description: Phase 15 direct-distribution QPU candidate on ibm_kingston. This tests a broad centered Gaussian-like Grover-Rudolph law on 64 midpoint cells after the Phase 14 affine n=6 result.
rationale: The broad centered Gaussian-like n=6 profile passed the Phase 15 backend-aware screening on ibm_kingston.
The selected opt=2, seed=34567 candidate had depth 193, 66 two-qubit gates, predicted noisy TVD 0.044257, and maximum noisy quantity-of-interest error 0.012389.
This profile is smoother and less one-sided than the affine n=6 law, so it tests whether tail and moment biases can be reduced.
The campaign measures only the direct Grover-Rudolph distribution; amplified QAE remains deferred.

selected_cases.label: centered Gaussian-like law, sigma 0.25, 64 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: Alternative smooth centered n=6 probability law to test whether direct integration improves beyond the affine n=6 result.

stopping_rules: Submit only after confirming the dry-run depth and two-qubit count match the Phase 15 backend-aware audit.
Promote as a Phase 15 direct-distribution result only if TVD stays below 0.055 and max cell deviation stays below 0.02.
Use quantity-specific errors for all integration claims.
Do not attach Grover amplification in this campaign.
